title: ResolutionRecord
description: One per-(example, arm) decision-conditioned resolution verdict, normalized from the upstream GitChameleon harness's eval_results CSV (GCB-ADR-0002). The upstream executable tests are the scorer; this record only carries their verdict plus provenance. Feeds the paired analysis with `passed` as the outcome.

example_id.description: The upstream dataset example id (the paired-join key).

passed.description: The upstream hidden-test verdict for the solution.

compiled.description: The upstream compile verdict, when the CSV carries it.

answering_model.description: The pinned answering model that produced the solutions.

upstream_harness.description: The GitChameleonBenchmark commit/tag that scored the solutions.
